checks: Initial real demo: 3 evaluated candidates and a solved pose.
Candidate switching, release states and locating the final IK check select the correct state.
Edit creates revision 2, preserves originals, invalidates the result and exports an unchecked draft.
Moving the hold beyond the wall produces a real boundary failure after recheck.
Repair returns to pass; repeated rechecks do not duplicate results; feedback is exported.
Malformed import keeps the current scene; exported bundle imports successfully.
Next-generation controls stay separate; generating B/10°/4 moves/fixed runs the real engine and locks editing.
Budget-exhausted import stays unknown and displays contact targets without an invented pose.
Arbitrary decimal edits validate; mobile import has an accessible name and the active step scrolls into view without horizontal page overflow.
